article.title: Profound宣布設新加坡亞太總部，辦公室計劃第四季啟用
article.title_en: Profound names Singapore its APAC headquarters, with office planned for Q4
article.summary: 據TNGlobal於11月2日引述的公司聲明，Profound將以新加坡支援亞太品牌。
article.summary_en: TNGlobal reported Profound’s Singapore headquarters announcement on November 2.
highlights: 區域團隊將服務東南亞、日本、澳洲及新西蘭。
公司計劃未來12個月在當地招聘逾15個職位。
highlights_en: Regional teams will serve Southeast Asia, Japan, Australia and New Zealand.
The company plans more than 15 local roles over 12 months.
article.why: 亞太品牌評估AI搜尋服務時，可進一步了解供應商的區域支援安排。
article.why_en: APAC brands can examine the vendor’s regional support arrangements.
article.next_step: 有採購需要的團隊，可詢問在地服務、語言支援及合約範圍。
article.next_step_en: Ask about local service, language coverage and contract scope.
article.detail: Profound宣布以新加坡作為亞太總部，區域領導、業務拓展及客戶團隊將設於當地。TNGlobal引述公司聲明指出，市中心辦公室計劃於2026年第四季啟用，招聘亦屬未來12個月的計劃。因此，總部布局已公布，不代表辦公室與所有職位已到位。這項擴展可供品牌評估供應商支援，尚不能據此推斷服務成效。
article.detail_en: TNGlobal attributes the headquarters and staffing plans to Profound’s statement. The Central Business District office is planned for Q4 2026. Announcing a regional base does not establish that the office or all planned roles are already operational, or that customer outcomes will improve.
